extension.description: Browse and play music from Navidrome, with scrobbling, offline downloads and optional integration into Kodi's Music library
extension.news: v0.7.0 (Navidrome 0.64) - New: Navidrome music in Kodi's own Music library (#9), off by default - New: up to 3 accounts with a main-menu switcher (#7) - New: Navidrome multi-library picker, Top Songs per artist - Fix: every track of a playlist is scrobbled, not only the first (#8) - Fix: offline downloads could not be saved at all - Fix: logged in again on every folder, which Navidrome 0.64 rate-limits - Fix: now-playing shows pause/stop; Similar Songs uses sonic similarity - New: setting to turn the playback report (position, pause, stop) off - New: with transcoding on, files already under the bitrate limit are no longer re-encoded (Navidrome 0.64) - Fix: with transcoding on, tracks shorter than 4 minutes were never scrobbled - Fix: multi-disc albums listed disc 1 and 2 interleaved - Fix: Kodi's home screen said the music library was empty after a sync, until a restart - Fix: removed Navidrome music left unused genres behind in Kodi's library
